name: 60005 · Arlington Hts, IL
findings: ZIP 60005 (Arlington Hts) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60005 (Arlington Hts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
